_comment: Settings for the daily build. Fill channelIds after check-tokens, brands with your channel names, formMap/thumbText per topic. See PLAYBOOK.md.
_target: Set to "live" once forms/<id>.js live selectors are verified; CI runners can reach government sites, but CAPTCHA fields are only shown, never filled.
_channels: language → token file suffix (upload/secrets/token-<suffix>.json). Non-EN/KO languages start on the EN channel.

ko.name: Leda
ko.prompt: 친근하고 차분한 여행 가이드처럼, 또렷하고 자연스럽게, 너무 빠르지 않게 한국어로 읽어 주세요. 지시문은 읽지 말고 아래 문장만 읽으세요:

en.name: Leda
en.prompt: Read the following like a friendly, calm travel guide: clear, natural and not too fast. Do not read this instruction, only the text below:

tts._fallback: If Gemini TTS fails (e.g. prepaid credits used up), the video is made with these voices instead and an issue is opened to notify the owner.

_formMap: calendar 서식/주제 → forms/<id>.js. Add a line each time you create a form definition.

affiliate._comment: Your affiliate links. Keys under default = country column of the calendar.

_affiliate: Travelpayouts / Impact tracking links per country. Keys are the 국가 column without the flag.
_publishWindow: Each video goes public at a random time between from:00 and to:00 in its channel timezone (KO: Asia/Seoul, EN: America/New_York).
_timezone: All channels publish on Korean time (06:00-10:00 KST window).

seo._lockedVideos: Video IDs whose title must not be auto-rotated (e.g. while a YouTube Studio A/B test runs). Tell Claude the ID when you start a test.

_shorts: One vertical Shorts clip (common-mistake moments) per main video, uploaded 1.5 h after it, within uploadsPerDay.
_uploadsPerDay: YouTube Data API default quota (10,000 units) ≈ 6 uploads/day per Google Cloud project. Raise after a quota increase.
_fillEmptySlots: Calendar slots whose form is not defined yet get the next not-yet-produced video (plan/produced.json).
_channelIds: Token key (ko, en, …) → YouTube channel id (UC…). Run the check-tokens workflow and copy the ids here; uploads refuse to go to a channel not listed for that token.
_bgm: Folder of background tracks (see assets/bgm/README.md). Empty folder = no music.
_extraTopics: Tutorials outside the calendar ("after you arrive" series). Produced before the calendar backlog; skipped until forms/<form>.js exists.
_maxVideosPerDay: Cap on main videos per day (quality over volume until monetization review). Raise later.
_playlists: Per-channel "trip prep" playlists, videos in this order (upload/maintain.js).
_liveForms: Forms recorded on the real website (form.stepsLive). Others use the practice page.
_channelSchedule: Extra channels: weekdays (0=Sun) and videos per day. gov = "My Channel: Gov" (secret YT_REFRESH_TOKEN_GOV), apps = "My Channel: Apps & AI" (secret YT_REFRESH_TOKEN_APPS).
_phraseQueue: Travel-phrase episodes built one per night (upload/phrases.js --next), after the tutorials, within the shared upload budget.

thumbText._: Thumbnail text per form:language = [where (white), what (yellow, biggest), why click (red chip)]. Keep each line short; every claim must be true for the video.

_parkedTopics: Finished tutorials that are not scheduled (the Apps & AI channel changed focus to AI assistants). Move back into extraTopics to publish.
